WITH af_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS cid
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 313217
),
first_af AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS af_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN af_concepts a ON a.cid = co.condition_concept_id
  GROUP BY co.person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_af_patients,
       MIN(af_date) AS earliest, MAX(af_date) AS latest
FROM first_af;
